meaning: P_STAGES sets the applied external pressure ramp as three stages, converting mmHg to dyn/cm² with the factor 1330 and peaking at P_PEAK_MMHG (8.0 mmHg unless _RAMP_AMP overrides it). It is the amplitude of the jugular-compression / pressure-ramp stimulus.

could_move.what: Parameters that read the protocol constants per model, so the forcing seen by m1/m3/m5
Patient-fit results, since fitted parameters absorb any change in stimulus amplitude

expectation: 8 mmHg peak is about 10640 dyn/cm². For small perturbations the response should scale roughly linearly with the peak, but this repo has bistability scripts, so near a threshold the change may be abrupt instead. The 1330 factor is a unit conversion, not a free choice.

check.why: Replots one deck at the stated amplitude without a re-fit, so the stimulus size and its response are visible in one cheap run.
